headline: Q2FY27 Update

highlights: Positives: • Revenue from operations grew 7% yoy and 2% qoq to Rs 650 crore in Q2FY27, in line with our estimate of Rs.649.6 crore. • In H1FY27, order wins stood at Rs.700 crore, including marquee wins in Tech & Payments solutions.
Negatives: • In Q2FY27, PAT has de-grown by 3% qoq to Rs. 81 crores, marginally lower than our estimate.
